scope: Static code and manifest review only. No model inference, candidate grade, or public-score estimate was produced by this review.

panel_contract.exposure: Historically exposed fold1 subset; the 41 groups are within the prior 457-group fold1 evaluation pool. This is serving/discovery evidence, not fresh CV confirmation.
panel_contract.feature_fixture_content: Feature-only parquet; the inference runner asserts absence of labels and is_scored and validates per-sequence feature/need_prediction digests against the frozen manifest.

checks.package_identity: Runner binds ZIP hash and exact member hashes to each build receipt, pins native library SHA ce179a68b7cd321368cc9ab73cdf1b79973afcdb8266ef8f6d7e613bb6f9874e, checks solution source binding, actual loaded precision q8vnni, imported library path, and active native member count.
checks.callback_contract: Runner processes each full sequence in causal order, checks warmup callbacks return None, and rejects wrong-shape or non-finite predictions; output panel is shape/dtype/finite checked and written without overwriting prior outputs.
checks.official_metric: Grader uses global_wp_clip2_v1 with mask need_prediction AND is_scored, clipping at +/-2, absolute clipped-target magnitude weights, pooled weighted Pearson per target, then equal-mean target aggregation. It validates selected fold1 evaluation membership and split/sequence/component mapping.
checks.bounded_review: Static reads and SHA-256 of small code/manifests only. No inference or large binary rehash performed by this reviewer.

qualifications: The runner performs one pass through each full sequence. It does not explicitly rerun the same sequences to assert bitwise reset replay; do not claim repeated-reset evidence from this panel.

The full valid.parquet SHA-256 is not recorded by the grader. It records path, size, and mtime and verifies selected row-group identities/masks against the fold1 split and feature manifest. Preserve this source-identity limitation in the grade interpretation.
A panel grade is exposed fold1 discovery evidence only; it does not establish a held-out result or public leaderboard score.
